bibliographic.title: Ocean Red
bibliographic.author: Palette
bibliographic.description:
Sailing a surreal, alien ocean is a being with direct relationships with the Sky, Sea, and Flesh of their body. Every day they have Orders from each they must try to complete, whether they want to or not.

You'll explore a window of their endless oceanic world, their relationships with the Sky, Sea, and Flesh, and perhaps even their memories as you go through a day in their life.

There are three endings to find and hundreds of unique passages. Each read is about an hour in length depending on your route.
